args.summary: Played two bronze-age battles. First, an open field attack, was lost with no clear sign of who was winning. The result screen came late and said "Mixed", which was confusing. Second, a base defense, was still running at step 48 with no result. Units are tiny in crowds. The Find and Enemy buttons helped me get around. Setup needs scrolling to reach Fight. I found no naval option. Alerts stack up. Overall it was playable but confusing for a newcomer.

thought: Enough testing; the battle drags on.
